preregistration: D-327 (the Phase 3 A1 pre-registration: (1)-(6)); D-318 (9); docs/phase3_design.md revision 2; machinery of D-244/D-298 (4d B), D-241/D-264 (4c), D-282 (TPR interval), D-177 (accuracy line)

input_verification.rule: D-170/D-172: a result with a flag enters no paper table until D-168 has passed

config.evaluation_half: E: the draw's evaluation part minus R_FRESH (1000 negatives)

predictions_record.checks: same pair, draws (index hash), inputs, parameters, variants and prediction-function sha256; every array equal to this run's recomputation bit for bit

auc_rule_source.kind: per-seed AUROC pre and frozen on the frozen eval split (D-241 (4))

selection.rule: D-117 criterion at the defender's L*: argmax over the selection record's arms of the mean ho20 AUROC at that layer, strict '>' in record order (ties to the first arm, as regularisation_sweep)

d282_tpr.at_c_nonzero: the clean positives against the exact shifted threshold t' = min{p : fl(p + delta . v) >= t} per draw and seed (exact because fl(p + s) is non-decreasing in p), reproduced draw by draw
d282_tpr.not_at_c_nonzero: restandardise_class_balanced, restandardise_traffic_1pct, refit_oracle: their positives move per draw under the attack (the D-156 band; their TPR equals its c = 0 value by translation invariance)
d282_tpr.draw_of_replicate: D-282: replicate r uses draw 1 + ((r - 1) mod n_draws)

draws_npz.rows: draw index (0 the frozen split); per-seed arrays have the seeds as columns

P-A1.1.over: every variant, c != 0, draw and seed

P-A1.3.cells: pair x c != 0 x variant (this pair); realised and predicted FPR/target as per-cell D-156 means
P-A1.3.expectation: at least 80% of cells within x1.5 over all pairs (scored on the pooled cells, not here)

P-A1.4.pooled: the pair-cluster bootstrap of D-241 (6) over the per-pair D-156 mean counts, across the nine pairs: not computed by this per-pair script

linear_identity.over: every variant and c != 0, on the frozen split (score units)
